# Reference Links

## Basic reference link

See the [full documentation][doc] for details.

[doc]: https://example.com/docs

## Reference with title

Read the [getting started guide][guide] first.

[guide]: https://example.com/getting-started "Getting Started Guide"

## Shortcut reference

Visit [Google] to search the web.

[Google]: https://google.com

## Reference with formatting

Check the [**important** notes][notes] carefully.

[notes]: https://example.com/notes

## Reference with numeric identifier

See [1] and [2] for related material.

[1]: https://example.com/ref-1
[2]: https://example.com/ref-2

## Reference used multiple times

The [doc] link appears again here, and once more in the [doc] section below.

[doc]: https://example.com/docs

## Reference with angle-bracket URL

See the [spec][spec] for exact syntax.

[spec]: <https://example.com/spec>

## Reference definition with no spaces

[compact]:https://example.com/compact

The compact link: [compact].

## Unused reference definition

The following is defined but never referenced.

[orphan]: https://example.com/orphan

## Reference inside list

- Item linking to [docs][doc]
- Item linking to [homepage][guide]
- Item linking to plain [Google]

## Reference inside table

| Resource | Link |
| --- | --- |
| Docs | [see here][doc] |
| Guide | [read this][guide] |
| Search | [Google] |

## Duplicate references (last wins)

[dup]: https://example.com/first
[dup]: https://example.com/second

The duplicate link: [dup].

## Final paragraph

Regular text at the end.
